# Data Source: identitynow_das_application

Use this data source to look up a Data Access Security application by ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "identitynow_das_application" "file_share" {
  id = "42"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Numeric application ID.

### Read-Only

- `dc_cluster_id` (String) ID of the cluster that classifies data.
- `description` (String) Description of the application.
- `name` (String) Display name of the application.
- `pc_cluster_id` (String) ID of the cluster that collects permissions.
- `rc_cluster_id` (String) ID of the cluster that crawls resources.
- `tags` (Attributes List) Tags of the application. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tags))
- `test_connection_date` (Number) Time of the last connection test, in milliseconds since the epoch.
- `test_connection_status` (String) Status of the last connection test.
- `type` (String) Name of the application type.

<a id="nestedatt--tags"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tags`

Read-Only:

- `id` (Number) Tag ID.
- `name` (String) Tag name.
